description: This file contains utility functions for command-line argument parsing and environment variable reading, including functions to consume and process flags of various types (string, integer, float, boolean) and a main parsing function.

methods.name: readEnvNumber
methods.description: Reads and parses a floating-point number from environment variables.

methods.name: consumeStringFlag
methods.description: Checks if a command-line argument matches a specific flag and returns the next index and value.

methods.name: consumeStringListFlag
methods.description: Checks if a command-line argument matches a specific flag and returns the associated string value.

methods.name: consumeIntFlag
methods.description: Checks if a command-line argument matches a specific flag and parses an integer value.

methods.name: consumeFloatFlag
methods.description: Checks if a command-line argument matches a specific flag and parses a float value.

methods.name: stringFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag handler for string flags.

methods.name: stringListFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag handler for string list flags.

methods.name: intFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag handler for integer flags with options.

methods.name: floatFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag handler for float flags with options.

methods.name: booleanFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag handler for boolean flags.

methods.name: parseFlagArgs
methods.description: Main function to parse command-line arguments based on specifications and options.
